status: Exploratory specifications fixed before running new outcomes; no significance-based selection

blindness.wage: Developed after seeing related FY2026 county wage and worksite-business decomposition results, including the existing report. Not a preregistered independent confirmation.
blindness.administration: No event-period administrative outcomes inspected before this declaration. Primary agency documents and schema names inspected.
blindness.earnings: No 2025 Q4 or later earnings opened. Existing frozen registry is preserved. No partial window or automatic scheduling.

wage.unit: filer-state-occupation; R7 candidate filer identifiers; distinct from worksite-business identity
wage.sample: Hourly worksite offers in (0,100], positive certified hours, decision October 1-June 30 in each FY; same counties and multi-state former regions as Track 1. Certified hours use original pooled FY2012-25 weekly-hours imputation. Allocate existing worksite rows equally across listed counties, then aggregate to state; never count a master in addition to allocated worksites.
wage.dose: FY2026 US skill-I state AEWR minus April 1 2025 regional AEWR, unchanged for placebos
wage.primary: Change in continuing filer-state-occupation mean offer on dose and former-region effects; baseline certified-hours weights
wage.fixed_composition: Filer-state mean wage change on common occupations, using baseline occupation hours shares renormalized over common occupations. Compare unrestricted continuing filer-state response on same and full continuer samples. Report baseline and current hours coverage; common-occupation selection is post-outcome conditioning.
wage.heterogeneity: R7 FY2025-26 primary mean-offer change only: interactions of dose with baseline premium >0.25, baseline contractor indicator, and baseline filer total hours above the median. Separate regressions; Holm adjust the three interaction p values and report Bonferroni simultaneous intervals as well as unadjusted intervals. Missing contractor or occupation remains unknown.
wage.selection: R7 baseline filer-state continuation in hourly offers and any certified positions; dose, former-region effects; equal and baseline-hours weights. Pre-wage/premium differences by continuation and dose interaction. No inference of random selection from insignificant tests.
wage.within_filer: R7 continuing filer-state unrestricted change on dose with filer and former-region effects, equivalent to filer-by-year effects in two-period levels; at least two continuing states per filer; both weights
wage.floor_audit: Receipt date is not job-order submission date. Skill, prevailing/collective wage, worker category and itinerary ambiguity prevent exact applicable-floor classification. Missing/unresolved effective floor is NA. Report separately receipt-aligned, five-common-SOC, single-state schedule-envelope comparisons for US/H2A skill-I/II plus observed state minimum; label as reference schedules, not established legal floors or market wages.
wage.inference: State deletion jackknife with t(G-1); CRV1 secondary. Any nonidentified deletion makes jackknife unavailable, never silently omit failed replicates.

administration.receipt_recoding: All October 1-18 submissions considered received October 18; cannot recover actual submission date
administration.cohort: R7 filer x worksite state x requested start month, observed in calendar requested-start years 2011 and 2012. Use primary/master case record only; collapse exact duplicates; conflicting dates/status/positions become unknown. Calendar years, not fiscal years, determine the event.
administration.prediction: Project each 2011/12 baseline case receipt, decision and requested-start calendar date to 2013 by year shift relative to its requested-start year; February 29 -> February 28. Predicted cohort start is median projected start date. Exposure is equal-case share of valid baseline projected receipt-to-decision closed intervals overlapping October 1-16. Require complete plausible baseline dates and nonnegative processing intervals in both years; document exclusions.
administration.primary: Any observed certification decided by historically predicted cohort start date; missing decisions for potentially timely certified cases -> unknown. No observed case -> zero observed timely certification, not proof of nonfiling. Keep all baseline cohorts in all years.
administration.model: Exposure x year, reference 2012; cohort effects and state x broad-season x year effects (contains state-by-year effects). Broad seasons are Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec.
sensitivities: state x month x year effects
diagnostics: 2014 and 2015 same-calendar temporal placebo contrasts relative to previous year
monthly decision and receipt counts including recoding mass
certifications by predicted start plus 7,14,30,60 days
administration.inference: State deletion jackknife t(G-1); temporal placebo estimates separately. One national interruption, no claim that cohorts are independent shocks. Conditional timing is selection-dependent; no shutdown IV for pure delay.

earnings.preserve: NAICS 111 private county weekly earnings, mean YoY log change 2025Q4-2026Q2; frozen 2022-24 intensity and dose; state effects; equal counties; state jackknife
earnings.preparation: Verify all base hashes, rebuild missing exposure from owner and demand exact frozen hash, reproduce tau2024 original estimate. Audit quarter keys, suppression, canonical geography and wage/employment aggregation on pre-policy data. Write dated correction amendment before accessing earnings.
earnings.release_gate: Publication metadata must verify 2026Q2 full data availability, then all six prior/current quarters must exist. Scheduled release 2026-12-02 10:00 America/New_York, verified 2026-11-14. No post-policy file open before release, hash and amendment checks.
earnings.UI: Source direct agriculture and contractor treatment independently from law/agency guidance; unresolved states explicitly ambiguous. Do not classify from observed employment discrepancies.
